name: yaml: block mappings and sequences nest by indentation
geml:
=== data {#y format=yaml}
name: geml
tags:
  - doc
  - spec
nested:
  a: 1
===

name: yaml: `- key: value` is a mapping in a sequence, `- - item` a sequence in one
geml:
=== data {#y format=yaml}
- k: 1
  j: 2
- - a
  - b
===

name: yaml: plain, single- and double-quoted scalars
geml:
=== data {#y format=yaml}
a: plain text
b: 'single ''quoted'''
c: "double \"quoted\""
===

name: yaml: the four block scalars
geml:
=== data {#y format=yaml}
lit: |
  one
  two
strip: |-
  one
fold: >
  one
  two
foldstrip: >-
  one
===

name: yaml: comments, a leading --- and a trailing ...
geml:
=== data {#y format=yaml}
---
# a comment
a: 1 # trailing
...
===

name: yaml: [] and {} are the empty sequence and the empty map
yaml: the core schema — null, booleans, integers in every base, floats
geml:
=== data {#y format=yaml}
n1: null
n2: ~
n3:
t: true
f: false
i: +80
h: 0x1f
o: 0o17
d: .5
e: 1e3
===

name: yaml: yes, no, on and off are strings, not the 1.1 booleans
geml:
=== data {#y format=yaml}
- yes
- no
- on
- off
===

name: yaml: an anchor is outside the subset — a parse error, never a guess
yaml: a tag is outside the subset
yaml: a flow collection other than [] and {} is outside the subset
yaml: .inf and .nan are outside the subset
yaml: a tab used for indentation is outside the subset
yaml: a key twice in one mapping is outside the value domain
